constraints: The trailing '*' parameter is only meaningful when 4D runs in remote mode: passing it retrieves a snapshot of the operations on the server instead of local operations; it is ignored when the command runs on 4D Server or 4D single-user.

overloadMerges.note: arrActivities is filled by the command (parameter table marks it with the '←' return arrow), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller wants all operation info returned as a single structured Object array, one element per operation.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a snapshot of in-progress 4D operations as a single array of structured Objects, one per operation (including nested subOperations).

params.name: arrActivities
params.description: Filled with one object per in-progress operation, describing message, timing, and context/details.
If passed, get the server's activity snapshot instead of the local one (remote mode only).

overloadMerges.note: All four/five array parameters are filled by the command (parameter table marks them with the '←' return arrow), so their direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller wants operation info spread across several parallel/synchronized flat arrays instead of one Object array.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a snapshot of in-progress 4D operations as several synchronized flat arrays (one element per operation per array) instead of one Object array.

params.name: arrStart
params.description: Start time of each operation, "yyyy:mm:dd hh:mm:ss:mls" format.

params.name: arrDuration
params.description: Duration of each operation, in milliseconds.
If passed, get the server's activity snapshot instead of the local one (remote mode only).
